capabilities: Export notes as single images, multi-image sets, long images, or PDF
Preview and edit layout before exporting without changing the note
Configure an author header card (avatar, name, date, font, alignment, spacing)
Add text or image watermarks that persist across multi-page exports
Batch export notes from a folder
disambiguation: Not a general screenshot tool; it targets Xiaohongshu-style multi-image share cards with author headers and watermarks.
extras: Manual installation only (build files placed in the vault); uses a new plugin id so it can be installed alongside the original; states it does not upload note content to any server and only fetches remote image URLs the user enters for avatars or watermarks.
intentEvidence: 基于原版 obsidian-export-image 改出来的 Obsidian 插件
motivation: The author wanted export output oriented toward content sharing (multi-image posts to Xiaohongshu, Moments, etc.) rather than generic export, building on the original plugin's solid export base.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export notes as polished multi-image social-media cards with author info, watermark, and WYSIWYG preview before exporting.
summary: Fork of obsidian-export-image that exports notes as shareable multi-image cards with an editable preview, author header, watermark, and Xiaohongshu-style pagination.
